reasoning_content:
The deployment via compose works end-to-end. The guide's instructions have been followed. Let me also verify DOCX via pandoc (no LLM needed). Let me create a docx with pandoc.

Actually, let me test image extraction path and DOCX. DOCX via pandoc. Let me generate a docx.

action.command:
docker exec workspace-tika-1 sh -c "printf '# Test Document\n\nThis is a docx pandoc extraction test.\n' > /tmp/t.md && pandoc /tmp/t.md -o /tmp/t.docx"
docker cp workspace-tika-1:/tmp/t.docx /tmp/t.docx
echo "=== DOCX extract ==="; curl -s -m 60 -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' --data-binary @/tmp/t.docx http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text | head -c 400; echo
echo "=== log ==="; docker compose -f /workspace/tika.yml logs 2>&1 | tail -2
